approval: Owner approved implementation on 2026-10-19; check plan and usage before activation.
beforeActivation: Verify current account plan, billing availability, usage and remaining allowances in the authorized account.
Confirm Pages Functions request allowance separately from Analytics Engine writes and reads.
Confirm an authorized binding-management route; the restricted Pages publisher does not grant binding writes.
Set production-only binding and runtime gate after deployment approval; no remote preview collection.
Rebuild with the public gate and confirm browser payload contains only the four allowed fields.
Verify a controlled fixed event appears in the intended dataset, then inspect the weighted report.
Check request abuse controls and usage alerts; Origin checks are not authentication and requests can be spoofed.
Record deployment ID, code hash, approvals, billing evidence and idempotency key.
rollback: Disable SITE_EVENTS_ENABLED immediately, then rebuild without PUBLIC_SITE_EVENTS_ENABLED. Keep PREVENT unchanged.

privacy.retention: 3 months per official documentation; recheck on activation
privacy.collectionScope: Allowlisted pages and booking/phone targets only; at most one event per target per page load.
privacy.sourceScope: Current page referrer class only. No session or cross-page attribution. Missing referrer is direct_unknown.

publicPricingSnapshot.paid: 10000000 writes/month then USD 0.25/million; 1000000 reads/month then USD 1/million
publicPricingSnapshot.availability: Public page says Analytics Engine usage is not currently billed; this is not account verification or a permanent guarantee.
